# Lungli — public pages

The pages a store listing and an emailed link need: home, Privacy Policy,
Terms of Service, Community Rules, account deletion, and the confirmation
landing page.

**Do not edit anything here by hand.** The pages are generated in the app's
repository from the same texts the app shows, and copied here by
`tool/publish_site.sh` there. A change made here is overwritten by the next
publish.

Hosting: any static host; the repository root is the site, and nothing needs
building.
